title: Layer ordering and cache effectiveness on source-only changes
hypothesis: Copying and installing dependencies before application source lets a source-only edit rebuild in well under a second of layer work, whereas copying the whole context first invalidates the dependency layer and makes every edit pay the full pip install cost. Expected effect size: large (d > 0.8), rebuild time ratio > 5x.

variants.name: deps-first
variants.description: COPY requirements.txt + pip install before COPY . .

notes: Each trial copies the fixture context to a scratch directory, warms the cache with one build, appends a comment to app.py, then times the rebuild.
